# Post-DSP stage-block policy baseline v1

`corpus.json` is the literal ordinary capture frozen before O policy admission,
with N admission active. It contains 6,796,606 bytes, SHA-256
`58eedb3de7187e20b3b3a61ba08d75cbc490fa32307985cc1e9facdfa3c924a2`.
Keep these bytes fixed.

The Scope capture and its repeat were independently qualified against actual
optimized binaries, source inputs and registered WAV media. The canonical body
removes exactly the outer variant, source-manifest hash and published-checkpoint
fields. Main's separate raw captures remain evidence; engine-dependent fields
are related by complete ordered-byte and typed-key validation.

The 19 actions record 34 ordinary helper calls. Exactly 22 are the selected
`build_stage` call after DSP read/check and before writer push: 19 Signal and
3 PreserveTape outputs, with 19 Plan and 3 real nested Cache executions. The
other 12 calls are saved-key output-bit scans and remain outside O. Fourteen
actions have zero selected calls. Warm paths, persistent restore, the complete
Source control, the signed Tape attempt and seven actual pre-O errors retain
their literal outcomes. The Bound case reaches an actual child-bound dispatch
and one selected Signal output; its family name does not establish that fact.

The old helper applies suppression before constructing its merged return Vec,
which this selected caller discards before pushing the block. Both actual
source-policy and returned-Vec capacities are observed separately. Layouts are
derived from capacity after construction, not allocator-call measurements.
Ordinary queries establish no O admission lease or admission-local work split.

Replay must validate actual ordered hash updates, the compiled ENGINE_PIN,
BLAKE3 finishes, typed returned keys, progress references and cache filenames.
The N KeysOnly row-byte counter and O observer calls-plus-rows byte counter must
each be recomputed from their own complete compact serialized payloads. Never
normalize captured fields, force an engine pin or regenerate this oracle.

The preceding 42 payloads remain unchanged. This corpus does not qualify O
admission, the saved-key output-bit policy producer, graph/PCM/dependency storage,
placed Root or Mix policy, whole preparation, or any product Gate.
